scope.separate_design_study: four fuel positions, exactly two UO2 and two MOX

gates.purpose: Verify exact model correspondence before numerical acceptance.
requirements: Record upstream repository and full commit SHA.
Diff generated geometry, materials, settings, boundary conditions, and material compositions against the selected primary benchmark case.
Record multigroup cross-section provenance, source hash, energy group boundaries, and generation procedure.
Explain and resolve production-versus-smoke materials XML differences.
Record OpenMC version and all runtime settings.
gates.pass_condition: Independent reviewer signs a machine-readable model-identity manifest.

gates.purpose: A screening check for the canonical UMMU arrangement only.

reference.source: OECD/NEA C5G7 benchmark report; see reports/physical_simulator_validation.md

gates.warning: These are provisional project screening gates, not official benchmark acceptance tolerances. G1 cannot pass while G0 is blocked.

gates.purpose: Check spatial response against benchmark-compatible reference quantities.
requirements: Identify the exact benchmark tally definition and normalization.
Compare compatible pin/assembly fission-rate or power distribution, not raw unnormalized flux alone.
Report RMS relative error and maximum absolute relative error with uncertainty treatment.
Preserve spatial indexing, units, normalization, and reference-data provenance.
gates.warning: Limits are provisional project screens until the selected primary benchmark's prescribed comparison metric is transcribed and reviewed.

gates.purpose: Compare the six assembly-placement layouts under a common budget.
requirements: Use identical batch/inactive/particle/thread settings across candidates.
Use at least three unique independent seeds per candidate for the initial screen.
Verify one unique statepoint hash per run and exact seed-to-statepoint correspondence.
Use a higher-budget confirmation run for any candidate whose ranking overlaps within combined uncertainty.
Report within-run Monte Carlo uncertainty separately from between-seed sample standard deviation.
gates.warning: The 2000/100/5000 profile is a proposed intermediate screen, not automatically benchmark-grade. Run a pilot and increase budget until convergence criteria are met.

gates.purpose: Prevent a descriptive k_eff ranking from being misrepresented as an optimization result.
requirements: Declare the design objective and its physical justification before viewing final candidate rankings.
Declare hard constraints, uncertainty treatment, and acceptance thresholds before evaluation.
Use the same candidate design space for exact enumeration and transport scoring.
Do not call highest/lowest k_eff safer or better without a separately justified objective.

recommended_default.validation_phase_objective: Minimize discrepancy between the canonical UMMU case and the official C5G7 reference quantities; this is benchmark verification, not candidate design optimization.
recommended_default.six_layout_phase: Report all six material-placement variants descriptively. Do not select a winner by highest or lowest k_eff without a separate physical design objective.
recommended_default.future_design_objective_template: After a justified k_eff acceptance band is declared and assembly-level tally normalization is validated, a separate exploratory objective may minimize assembly-integrated fission-rate peaking F_fission = max_a(R_a)/mean_a(R_a), where R_a is the integrated fission-rate tally for fuel assembly a.
recommended_default.reason_not_applied: The current tally/reference mapping and intended design target have not yet been approved; the existing 51x51 mesh scores are not automatically absolute power.

explicit_nonclaims: Passing these project screens is not reactor-safety certification.
A numerical match alone does not prove model identity.
The four-variable UO2/MOX QUBO is a new assembly-placement encoding, not the legacy burnup-state QUBO.
The proposed intermediate compute profile is not represented as executed or converged.
